title: brilliant
blurb: An AI calendar that sits on top of Google Calendar. Schedule, manage, and reorganize events by just talking to it. Because dragging events around is not a personality.
body:
An AI calendar that sits on top of Google Calendar. Schedule, manage, and reorganize events by just talking to it.

Because dragging events around is not a personality.

Built with Next.js, Google Calendar API integration, and natural language schedule manipulation.

title: spotify-now-playing
blurb: A minimalist service that shows what you're listening to on a profile, site, or blog. Yes, it's on the lanyard card. That's the flex.
body:
A minimalist service that shows what you're listening to on a profile, site, or blog.

Yes, it's on the lanyard card. That's the flex.

Provides real-time cached Spotify track data via clean SVG embeds and API endpoints.

title: stickle
blurb: Persistent sticky notes on any webpage, with export to Notion. Sticky notes for the internet.
body:
A browser extension that lets you drop persistent, positioned sticky notes anywhere on any webpage, with full export to Notion.

Sticky notes for the internet.

title: This site
blurb: A monochrome personal system featuring Verlet lanyard physics, 2D canvas stipple morphing, and liquid glass notch nav.
body: Case study for this site's own build: Verlet rope physics for an interactive ID badge, responsive canvas stipple particle engine with text-aware dimming, and an adaptive notch navigation that morphs into a liquid glass pill.
